about: temporal-model's former pyro-annotator testbed, registered with --source pyro-annotator-testbed. Labels from the testbed; boxes from pyronear/yolov11s v8.2.0 (1024 px, NMS IoU 0.2) matched to the platform detection box (IoU >= 0.1); smoke class 0, fp class 99 + score. Splits 40/10/50 by groups: smoke by camera view or start within 30 min on any camera, fp by camera view + box IoU >= 0.3; any two sequences sharing an image (by content, across smoke and fp) share a split.
